description: Generated deepcopy functions for Kubernetes RBAC API v1 types, including ClusterRole, Role, bindings, and related structures.

classes.name: AggregationRule
classes.description: Represents an aggregation rule for RBAC roles.

classes.name: ClusterRole
classes.description: Defines a cluster-wide role with rules and optional aggregation.

classes.name: ClusterRoleBinding
classes.description: Binds a ClusterRole to subjects at the cluster level.

classes.name: PolicyRule
classes.description: Defines a set of permissions for RBAC roles.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Defines a namespace-scoped role with rules.

classes.name: RoleBinding
classes.description: Binds a Role to subjects within a namespace.

classes.name: Subject
classes.description: Represents a subject (user, group, service account) in RBAC.

methods.name: DeepCopyInto
methods.description: Copies receiver into out, used for deep copying.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the receiver.

methods.name: DeepCopyObject
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the object as runtime.Object.
